checks.after: Agricultural officers are carefully selected and encouragement and assessment are pressed to the utmost, so each man tends a full hundred mu without relying on ox power;
checks.reason: Original EN misreads 高選 as high officers, weakens 務盡勸課, and narrows 不假牛力 to borrowing oxen. The replacement renders carefully selected officers, encouragement and assessment pressed to the utmost, and not relying on ox power, consistent with the pending s0264 literal; it remains the answer to the 何也 question in s0263.

checks.after: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; people wander and perish from hunger and cold, falling one after another into the ditches.
checks.reason: Original EN omits 千里無煙, cold, 流 and 相繼, and makes hunger fill the ditches. The replacement restores a thousand li without smoke, people wandering and perishing amid hunger and cold, and falling one after another into the ditches, matching 饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑 and the pending s0272 literal.
